source.text: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֤ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ עַל־כָּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֗יא הַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ית לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all [the] people of Judah in the year the fourth of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, it [was] the year the first of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon,

en.L: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah (that [was] the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon),
en.B: This message came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah in the fourth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, in what was also the first year of the reign of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave Jeremiah a message about all the people of Judah. It came in the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah. That was the first year that Nebuchadrezzar was king of Babylon.

es.L: La palabra que vino a Jeremías acerca de todo el pueblo de Judá, en el año cuarto de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá (que [era] el año primero de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia),
es.B: Este mensaje vino a Jeremías acerca de todo el pueblo de Judá en el cuarto año del reinado de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, que era también el primer año del reinado de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Jeremías un mensaje acerca de todo el pueblo de Judá. Le llegó en el cuarto año en que Joacim hijo de Josías era rey de Judá. Ese fue el primer año en que Nabucodorosor era rey de Babilonia.

fr.L: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie au sujet de tout le peuple de Juda, la quatrième année de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda (c’[était] la première année de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone),
fr.B: Ce message fut adressé à Jérémie au sujet de tout le peuple de Juda la quatrième année du règne de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda, qui était aussi la première année du règne de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Jérémie un message au sujet de tout le peuple de Juda. C’était la quatrième année où Joïaqim, fils de Josias, était roi de Juda. C’était la première année où Nabuchodonosor était roi de Babylone.

sw.L: Neno lililomjia Yeremia kuhusu watu wote wa Yuda, katika mwaka wa nne wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda (huo [ulikuwa] mwaka wa kwanza wa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli),
sw.B: Ujumbe huu ulimjia Yeremia kuhusu watu wote wa Yuda katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, ambao pia ulikuwa mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Yeremia ujumbe kuhusu watu wote wa Yuda. Ulikuja katika mwaka wa nne ambao Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia alikuwa mfalme wa Yuda. Huo ulikuwa mwaka wa kwanza ambao Nebukadreza alikuwa mfalme wa Babeli.

vi.L: Lời đến với Giê-rê-mi về toàn dân Giu-đa, vào năm thứ tư đời Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa (ấy [là] năm thứ nhất đời Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn),
vi.B: Sứ điệp này đến với Giê-rê-mi về toàn dân Giu-đa vào năm thứ tư triều Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, cũng là năm thứ nhất triều Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Giê-rê-mi một sứ điệp về toàn dân Giu-đa. Sứ điệp đến vào năm thứ tư Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua Giu-đa. Đó là năm thứ nhất Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa làm vua Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김의 제4년, 곧 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살의 원년에, 유다의 모든 백성에 관하여 예레미야에게 임한 말씀,
ko.B: 이것은 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다를 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해, 곧 느부갓레살이 바빌론을 다스린 첫해에, 유다의 모든 백성에 관하여 예레미야에게 임한 말씀이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다의 모든 백성에 관한 말씀을 예레미야에게 주셨다. 그때는 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다의 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해였다. 그해는 느부갓레살이 바빌론의 왕이 된 첫해였다.

pt.L: A palavra que veio a Jeremias a respeito de todo o povo de Judá, no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá (aquele [era] o primeiro ano de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia),
pt.B: Esta mensagem veio a Jeremias a respeito de todo o povo de Judá no quarto ano do reinado de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, que foi também o primeiro ano do reinado de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} deu a Jeremias uma mensagem a respeito de todo o povo de Judá. Ela veio no quarto ano em que Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, era rei de Judá. Esse foi o primeiro ano em que Nabucodorosor era rei da Babilônia.

am.L: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት (ይህም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የናቡከደነፆር የመጀመሪያው ዓመት [ነበረ])፣ ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል፣
am.B: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም የንግሥና ዘመን በአራተኛው ዓመት፣ ማለትም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በነገሠ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት፣ ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይህ መልእክት ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ለኤርምያስ መልእክት ሰጠው። ይህም የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ኢዮአቄም በይሁዳ ላይ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ነበር። ያም ዓመት ናቡከደነፆር በባቢሎን ላይ የነገሠበት የመጀመሪያ ዓመት ነበር።

hi.L: वह वचन जो यहूदा के सब लोगों के विषय में यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा, यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के पुत्र यहोयाकीम के चौथे वर्ष में (वह बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर का पहला वर्ष [था]),
hi.B: यह वचन यहूदा के सब लोगों के विषय में यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा, यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के पुत्र यहोयाकीम के राज्य के चौथे वर्ष में, जो बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर के राज्य का पहला वर्ष भी था।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यिर्मयाह को यहूदा के सब लोगों के बारे में एक संदेश दिया। यह योशिय्याह के बेटे यहोयाकीम के यहूदा का राजा होने का चौथा वर्ष था। वही नबूकदरेस्सर के बाबुल का राजा होने का पहला वर्ष था।

ru.L: Слово, которое было к Иеремии обо всём народе Иуды в четвёртый год Иоакима, сына Иосии, царя Иудейского (это [был] первый год Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона),
ru.B: Вот слово, которое пришло к Иеремии обо всём народе Иуды в четвёртый год царствования Иоакима, сына Иосии, царя Иуды, — в первый год царствования Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал Иеремии слово обо всём народе Иуды. Это было в четвёртый год царствования Иоакима, сына Иосии, царя Иуды. Тогда шёл первый год царствования Навуходорносора, царя Вавилона.

ja.L: ユダの王、ヨシヤの子ヨヤキムの第四年、すなわちバビロンの王ネブカドネツァルの第一年に、ユダのすべての民について、エレミヤに臨んだ言葉。
ja.B: ユダの王、ヨシヤの子ヨヤキムの治世の第四年、それはバビロンの王ネブカドネツァルの治世の第一年でもあったが、その年に、ユダのすべての民についての言葉がエレミヤに臨んだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ユダのすべての人々について、エレミヤにお告げを与えられました。それは、ヨシヤの息子ヨヤキムがユダの王になって四年目のことでした。その年は、ネブカドネツァルがバビロンの王になって一年目でした。

uk.L: Слово, що було до Єремії про весь народ Юди, у четвертому році Йоакима, сина Йосії, царя Юдеї (це [був] перший рік Навуходоносора, царя Вавилону),
uk.B: Це послання прийшло до Єремії про весь народ Юдеї в четвертому році царювання Йоакима, сина Йосії, царя Юдеї, що був також першим роком царювання Навуходоносора, царя Вавилону.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав Єремії послання про весь народ Юдеї. Воно прийшло в четвертому році, відколи Йоаким, син Йосії, був царем Юдеї. Це був перший рік, відколи Навуходоносор був царем Вавилону.

decisions.choice: the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the first year of Nebuchadrezzar: 605 BC
decisions.reason: Jehoiakim became king in 609 BC, so his fourth year was 605 BC. That was the year Nebuchadrezzar defeated Egypt at Carchemish (46:2, dated to the same year) and succeeded his father as king of Babylon. This is the first time Jeremiah dates a message by a foreign king's reign: from now on Babylon sets the calendar for Judah. The same year is the setting of chapter 36 (36:1) and of chapter 45. Daniel 1:1 speaks of the third year of Jehoiakim for Nebuchadnezzar's first move against Jerusalem; that probably counts Jehoiakim's years from his first full year rather than from his accession. The Greek translation lacks the words "that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar" (see the note at 1:1; this is from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: the word ... concerning all the people of Judah: a message about them and addressed to them
decisions.reason: The phrase introduces a message about the whole people; verse 2 adds that Jeremiah spoke it to them. It is the summing up of his preaching up to this point (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar: the form of the name with r, kept as the Hebrew has it here
decisions.reason: Jeremiah and Ezekiel mostly spell the king's name Nebuchadrezzar, close to the Babylonian Nabu-kudurri-usur ("Nabu, protect my heir"). Kings, Chronicles, Daniel and a few places in Jeremiah (27-29) spell it Nebuchadnezzar. Both name the same king, who reigned 605-562 BC.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar
decisions.reason: Each verse keeps the form of the name its Hebrew uses, so readers can see the two spellings; m3 explains that they are one man.

decisions.choice: a parenthesis (Literal); a relative clause (Balanced); a separate sentence (Readable); a comma at the end of the verse (Literal)
decisions.reason: The second date explains the first. The sentence runs on into verse 2, so Literal ends with a comma; Balanced and Readable finish the date here and let verse 2 begin a new sentence. Balanced uses the book's heading wording ("This message came to Jeremiah") and the dating formula "in the fourth year of the reign of", and Readable says plainly that the LORD gave the message.

decisions.choice: en el año cuarto de X (Literal); en el cuarto año del reinado de X (Balanced); en el cuarto año en que X era rey (Readable)
decisions.reason: The dated headings of Jeremiah keep this pattern at each level through the block, as the English note sets for "in the Nth year of X".

decisions.choice: katika mwaka wa nne wa X (Literal); ... wa utawala wa X (Balanced); ... ambao X alikuwa mfalme (Readable)
decisions.reason: The dated heading at each level as the English Jeremiah note sets it.

decisions.choice: dated headings: "la quatrième année de X" (L); "la quatrième année du règne de X" (B); "la quatrième année où X était roi" (R)
decisions.reason: The French wording of Jeremiah's dated headings for Jeremiah 18-34, following the English pattern by level and the Kings note's regnal formulas.

decisions.choice: "năm thứ tư đời X" / "năm thứ tư triều X" / "năm thứ tư X làm vua"
decisions.reason: The terms note's pattern for Jeremiah's dated headings at each level, after the regnal formulas of Kings.

decisions.choice: "여호야김의 제4년" (L); "여호야김이 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해" (B); "여호야김이 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's dated-heading formula, after Kings, with years in figures at every level.

decisions.choice: Literal ends with a comma and runs into verse 2
decisions.reason: As the English Literal, the heading runs on into "which Jeremiah the prophet spoke"; Balanced and Readable close verse 1 as a sentence.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change; this chapter's Amharic has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: नबूकदरेस्सर, kept apart from नबूकदनेस्सर
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the form of the name with r (Nebuchadrezzar), and the terms note keeps each form where the Hebrew has it, so this verse has नबूकदरेस्सर; chapters 27-29, which spell it with n, have नबूकदनेस्सर as Kings and Daniel do. They are one king. The dating keeps the wording of 1:2-3 at each level.

decisions.choice: Навуходорносор
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here spells the king's name with r (Nebuchadrezzar), and the English keeps it apart from Nebuchadnezzar; Russian keeps the two apart too, Навуходорносор for this form and Навуходоносор (as Kings and Daniel) for the other.

decisions.choice: bashshanah haruvi'it … hashshanah hari'shonit "第四年 … 第一年" (L), "治世の第四年 … 治世の第一年" (B), "王になって四年目 … 王になって一年目" (R).
decisions.reason: The JER year forms (1:2-3); Nebuchadrezzar ネブカドネツァル, the one form for both spellings (m3).

decisions.choice: The parenthesis of the English L ("that was the first year …") becomes an apposition (L), a clause (B) or a sentence (R).
decisions.reason: Japanese has no parenthesis in running text.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ עַל־כָּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶ֛ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

vi.B: Tiên tri Giê-rê-mi đã công bố sứ điệp ấy cho toàn dân Giu-đa và mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ông nói:

ko.L: 곧 예언자 예레미야가 유다의 모든 백성과 예루살렘의 모든 주민에게 전하여 말한 것이다.
ko.B: 예언자 예레미야는 그 말씀을 유다의 모든 백성과 예루살렘에 사는 모든 사람에게 전했다. 그가 말했다.

pt.B: O profeta Jeremias a anunciou a todo o povo de Judá e a todos os que moravam em Jerusalém. Ele disse:
pt.R: O profeta Jeremias contou essa mensagem a todo o povo de Judá e a todos os que moravam em Jerusalém. Ele disse:

am.L: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ ሁሉ የተናገረው [ይህ ነው]፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦
am.B: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ይህን ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተናገረ። እንዲህም አለ፦
am.R: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ይህን ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩት ሁሉ ነገራቸው። እንዲህም አለ፦

hi.L: जो यिर्मयाह भविष्यद्वक्ता ने यहूदा के सब लोगों से और यरूशलेम के सब निवासियों से कहा:
hi.B: यिर्मयाह भविष्यद्वक्ता ने यह वचन यहूदा के सब लोगों को और यरूशलेम में रहनेवाले हर एक को सुनाया। उसने कहा:
hi.R: यिर्मयाह नबी ने यह संदेश यहूदा के सब लोगों को और यरूशलेम में रहनेवाले सब लोगों को सुनाया। उसने कहा:

ru.L: которое Иеремия-пророк сказал всему народу Иуды и всем жителям Иерусалима, говоря:
ru.B: Пророк Иеремия передал его всему народу Иуды и всем жителям Иерусалима. Он сказал:
ru.R: Пророк Иеремия передал это слово всему народу Иуды и всем, кто жил в Иерусалиме. Он сказал:

ja.L: 預言者エレミヤは、それをユダのすべての民とエルサレムのすべての住民に語って、言った。
ja.B: 預言者エレミヤは、それをユダのすべての民とエルサレムに住むすべての人に語った。彼は言った。
ja.R: 預言者エレミヤは、それをユダのすべての人々と、エルサレムに住むすべての人に語りました。エレミヤは言いました。

uk.L: яке Єремія, пророк, говорив усьому народові Юди і всім мешканцям Єрусалима, кажучи:
uk.B: Пророк Єремія переказав його всьому народові Юдеї і всім, хто жив у Єрусалимі. Він сказав:
uk.R: Пророк Єремія переказав його всім людям Юдеї і всім, хто жив у Єрусалимі. Він сказав:

decisions.choice: which Jeremiah spoke: the message of verse 1, now delivered by the prophet to the people
decisions.reason: The relative word picks up "the word" of verse 1. Verses 3-14 are Jeremiah's own speech, in which he reports what the LORD has said.

decisions.choice: saying: (Literal); He said: (Balanced, Readable), with Jeremiah's speech opening in verse 3
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's speech runs from verse 3 to verse 14, so its quotation marks open at verse 3 and close at verse 14.

decisions.choice: भविष्यद्वक्ता (L, B); नबी (R)
decisions.reason: The prophet is भविष्यद्वक्ता at Literal and Balanced and नबी at Readable, as in the New Testament (Matthew 2:17 "यिर्मयाह भविष्यद्वक्ता", "यिर्मयाह नबी") and the history books. Kept through this block.

decisions.choice: The book's narration: plain (L, B), です・ます (R); Jeremiah's speech (25:3-14) is the prophet speaking to the people: plain at every level, あなたがた (L, B), あなたたち (R).
decisions.reason: JER conventions: narration by the narrative rule, the prophet's own words plain with authority.

source.text: מִן־שְׁלֹ֣שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֡ה לְיֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמוֹן֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְעַ֣ד׀הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה זֶ֚ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וָאֲדַבֵּ֧ר אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְדַבֵּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From thirteen year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, and until the day this, this three and twenty year[s] has come [the] word of Yahweh to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, and not you have listened.

en.L: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, until this day, these twenty-three years, the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, and you have not listened.
en.B: "For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, up to this very day, the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has come to me. Again and again I have spoken to you, but you have not listened.
en.R: "For twenty-three years {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been giving me {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messages. It began in the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, and it has gone on until today. I have told you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} messages over and over, but you have not listened.

es.L: «Desde el año trece de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá, hasta este día, estos veintitrés años, ha venido a mí la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he hablado, madrugando y hablando, y no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado.
es.B: «Durante veintitrés años, desde el año trece del reinado de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá, hasta el día de hoy, la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha venido a mí. Una y otra vez {{plural_you:les|os}} he hablado, pero no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado.
es.R: «Durante veintitrés años {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha estado dando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajes. Empezó en el año trece en que Josías hijo de Amón era rey de Judá, y ha seguido hasta hoy. Una y otra vez {{plural_you:les|os}} he dado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mensajes, pero no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado.

fr.L: « Depuis la treizième année de Josias fils d’Amon, roi de Juda, jusqu’à ce jour, voici vingt-trois ans que la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} m’est adressée, et je vous ai parlé, me levant de bonne heure et parlant, et vous n’avez pas écouté.
fr.B: « Depuis vingt-trois ans, depuis la treizième année du règne de Josias fils d’Amon, roi de Juda, jusqu’à aujourd’hui, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} m’a été adressée. Je vous ai parlé sans relâche, mais vous n’avez pas écouté.
fr.R: « Depuis vingt-trois ans, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me donne {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messages. Cela a commencé la treizième année où Josias, fils d’Amon, était roi de Juda, et cela a continué jusqu’à aujourd’hui. Je vous ai transmis {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} messages encore et encore, mais vous n’avez pas écouté.

sw.L: "Tangu mwaka wa kumi na tatu wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni, mfalme wa Yuda, mpaka siku hii ya leo, miaka hii ishirini na mitatu, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limekuwa likinijia, nami nimesema nanyi, nikiamka mapema na kusema, lakini hamkusikiliza.
sw.B: "Kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu, tangu mwaka wa kumi na tatu wa utawala wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni, mfalme wa Yuda, mpaka leo hii, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limekuwa likinijia. Nimesema nanyi tena na tena, lakini hamkusikiliza.
sw.R: "Kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekuwa akinipa ujumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ilianza katika mwaka wa kumi na tatu ambao Yosia mwana wa Amoni alikuwa mfalme wa Yuda, na imeendelea mpaka leo. Nimewaambia ujumbe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mara nyingi sana, lakini hamkusikiliza.

vi.L: "Từ năm thứ mười ba đời Giô-si-a con trai A-môn, vua Giu-đa, cho đến ngày nay, đã hai mươi ba năm nay lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với tôi, và tôi đã nói với các người, dậy sớm mà nói, nhưng các người không nghe.
vi.B: "Đã hai mươi ba năm nay, từ năm thứ mười ba triều Giô-si-a con trai A-môn, vua Giu-đa, cho đến chính ngày hôm nay, lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn đến với tôi. Tôi đã nói với các người hết lần này đến lần khác, nhưng các người không nghe.
vi.R: "Đã hai mươi ba năm nay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban sứ điệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi. Việc ấy bắt đầu từ năm thứ mười ba Giô-si-a con trai A-môn làm vua Giu-đa và kéo dài cho đến hôm nay. Tôi đã nhiều lần nói cho các người biết sứ điệp của Ngài, nhưng các người không nghe.

ko.L: "유다 왕 아몬의 아들 요시야의 제13년부터 오늘까지, 이 23년 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임했고, 나는 너희에게 일찍 일어나 말하며 전했으나 너희는 듣지 않았다.
ko.B: "아몬의 아들 요시야가 유다를 다스린 지 13년째 되는 해부터 바로 오늘까지, 23년 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임했다. 나는 너희에게 거듭거듭 말했지만, 너희는 듣지 않았다.
ko.R: "23년 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀을 주셨다. 그 일은 아몬의 아들 요시야가 유다의 왕이 된 지 13년째 되는 해에 시작되어 오늘까지 계속되었다. 나는 너희에게 그분의 말씀을 몇 번이고 전했다. 그러나 너희는 듣지 않았다.

pt.L: "Desde o décimo terceiro ano de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até este dia, estes vinte e três anos, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tem vindo a mim, e eu lhes tenho falado, madrugando e falando, e vocês não ouviram.
pt.B: "Durante vinte e três anos, desde o décimo terceiro ano do reinado de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até o dia de hoje, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tem vindo a mim. Repetidas vezes eu falei a vocês, mas vocês não ouviram.
pt.R: "Durante vinte e três anos {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem me dado as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mensagens. Isso começou no décimo terceiro ano em que Josias, filho de Amom, era rei de Judá, e continua até hoje. Eu contei a vocês as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mensagens muitas e muitas vezes, mas vocês não escutaram.

am.L: «ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሞን ልጅ ከኢዮስያስ ከአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት አንሥቶ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፣ እነዚህን ሃያ ሦስት ዓመታት፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ እኔ መጥቷል፤ እኔም ማልጄ እየተናገርኩ ነገርኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም።
am.B: «ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሞን ልጅ ከኢዮስያስ የንግሥና ዘመን ከአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት አንሥቶ እስከዚህች ቀን ድረስ ለሃያ ሦስት ዓመታት {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ እኔ ሲመጣ ቆይቷል። ደጋግሜ ነገርኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም።
am.R: «ለሃያ ሦስት ዓመታት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልእክቶቹን ሲሰጠኝ ቆይቷል። ይህም የጀመረው የአሞን ልጅ ኢዮስያስ በይሁዳ ላይ በነገሠ በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ቀጥሏል። እኔም መልእክቶቹን ደጋግሜ ነገርኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም።

hi.L: "आमोन के पुत्र यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के तेरहवें वर्ष से आज के दिन तक, इन तेईस वर्षों से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन मेरे पास पहुँचता रहा है, और मैं तड़के उठ उठकर तुमसे कहता रहा हूँ, पर तुमने नहीं सुना।
hi.B: "आमोन के पुत्र, यहूदा के राजा योशिय्याह के राज्य के तेरहवें वर्ष से लेकर आज के दिन तक, तेईस वर्ष से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन मेरे पास पहुँचता रहा है। मैंने बार-बार तुमसे कहा है, पर तुमने नहीं सुना।
hi.R: "तेईस वर्ष से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मुझे अपने संदेश देते आए हैं। यह आमोन के बेटे योशिय्याह के यहूदा का राजा होने के तेरहवें वर्ष में शुरू हुआ, और आज तक चलता रहा है। मैंने बार-बार उनके संदेश तुम्हें सुनाए हैं, पर तुमने नहीं सुना।

ru.L: «С тринадцатого года Иосии, сына Амона, царя Иудейского, и до этого дня, вот уже двадцать три года, было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} ко мне, и я говорил вам, вставая рано и говоря, но вы не слушали.
ru.B: «Двадцать три года, с тринадцатого года царствования Иосии, сына Амона, царя Иуды, и до этого дня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обращался ко мне. Я снова и снова говорил вам, но вы не слушали.
ru.R: «Двадцать три года {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} давал мне свои слова. Это началось в тринадцатый год царствования Иосии, сына Амона, царя Иуды, и продолжается до сегодняшнего дня. Я снова и снова передавал вам {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слова, но вы не слушали.

ja.L: 「ユダの王、アモンの子ヨシヤの第十三年から今日まで、この二十三年の間、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がわたしに臨み、わたしはあなたがたに朝早くから語り続けたが、あなたがたは聞かなかった。
ja.B: 「ユダの王、アモンの子ヨシヤの治世の第十三年から今日まで、二十三年の間、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がわたしに臨んだ。わたしはあなたがたに繰り返し語ってきたが、あなたがたは聞かなかった。
ja.R: 「二十三年の間、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしにお告げを与えてこられた。それは、アモンの息子ヨシヤがユダの王になって十三年目に始まり、今日まで続いている。わたしはそのお告げを、何度も何度もあなたたちに語ってきた。しかし、あなたたちは聞かなかった。

uk.L: «Від тринадцятого року Йосії, сина Амона, царя Юдеї, і до цього дня, ось уже двадцять три роки, було до мене слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і я говорив вам, рано встаючи і говорячи, а ви не слухали.
uk.B: «Двадцять три роки, від тринадцятого року царювання Йосії, сина Амона, царя Юдеї, і аж до цього дня, до мене було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Знову й знову я говорив вам, але ви не слухали.
uk.R: «Двадцять три роки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} давав мені свої послання. Це почалося в тринадцятому році, відколи Йосія, син Амона, був царем Юдеї, і триває аж до сьогодні. Я раз у раз переказував вам {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} послання, але ви не слухали.

decisions.choice: twenty-three years: from 627 BC to 605 BC, counting both the first and the last year
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's call came in Josiah's thirteenth year (1:2). Josiah reigned thirty-one years (2 Kings 22:1), which leaves nineteen years of his reign; Jehoahaz reigned three months, and this is Jehoiakim's fourth year (verse 1). Counted the ancient way, with the first and last years both included, that gives twenty-three years.

decisions.choice: rising early and speaking: speaking again and again, without giving up
decisions.reason: As in 7:13. The form of the first verb here is unusual (it looks like an Aramaic spelling), but the phrase is the one Jeremiah uses throughout for God's untiring warnings.

decisions.choice: I have spoken ... you have not listened: the prophet's whole ministry summed up as one long appeal refused
decisions.reason: The perfect verbs look back over the whole twenty-three years. Verse 4 sets the LORD's sending of all his prophets beside Jeremiah's own preaching.

decisions.choice: rising early and speaking (L); again and again (B); over and over (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase throughout Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: giving me his messages ... told you his messages
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "the word of the LORD came to me" means (as at 1:2), and that what Jeremiah spoke was that message.

decisions.choice: madrugando y hablando (Literal); una y otra vez (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The idiom of rising early keeps the wording the terms note sets for the block (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: nikiamka mapema na kusema (Literal); tena na tena (Balanced); mara nyingi sana (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for Jeremiah's "rising early and speaking" at each level.

decisions.choice: "me levant de bonne heure et parlant" (L); "sans relâche" (B); "encore et encore" (R)
decisions.reason: The French wording the terms note sets for this phrase throughout Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "dậy sớm mà nói" / "hết lần này đến lần khác" / "nhiều lần"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for "rising early and speaking", used each time it returns in these chapters (verse 4; 26:5; 29:19; 32:33).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah says "tôi" and "các người" to the people
decisions.reason: The prophet rebuking the people says "các người" (terms note); God's own words quoted inside (verses 5-7) keep his "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: "일찍 일어나 말하며" (L); "거듭거듭" (B); "몇 번이고" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "rising early and speaking" in Jeremiah (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks to the people in the plain style ("너희", "듣지 않았다")
decisions.reason: A prophet's sermon to the people, as in 19:14-15; God is spoken of with the honorific.

decisions.choice: madrugando e falando (L); repetidas vezes (B); muitas e muitas vezes (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set at 7:13 for the whole book (m2): Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of rising early to speak, and Balanced and Readable give its sense. Jeremiah speaks to the people with "vocês".

decisions.choice: "ማልጄ እየተናገርኩ" (rising early and speaking)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of rising early to speak, which Amharic "ማለደ" (to rise early, to do something first thing) carries; Balanced and Readable say what it means, "ደጋግሜ" (again and again). The same pair is used wherever Jeremiah has the idiom.

decisions.choice: तड़के उठ उठकर कहता रहा (L); बार-बार (B, R)
decisions.reason: The idiom "rising early and speaking" keeps the wording of 2 Chronicles 36:15 in this translation: Literal keeps the picture (तड़के उठ उठकर), Balanced and Readable give its sense, "again and again". The same wording holds at 25:4, 26:5, 29:19 and wherever it recurs in the book.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns ("his") with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उनके). This holds for every record of this file.

decisions.choice: вставая рано и говоря (L); снова и снова (B, R)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's idiom "rising early and speaking" keeps its form at Literal and is given its sense, "again and again", at Balanced and Readable, one wording per level through this block.

decisions.choice: 'ashkem vedabber "朝早くから語り続けた" (L), "繰り返し語ってきた" (B), "何度も何度も…語ってきた" (R), the JER form (7:13), here in Jeremiah's own mouth.
decisions.reason: JER conventions for the rising-early idiom.

source.text: וְשָׁלַח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲבָדָ֧יו הַנְּבִאִ֛ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־הִטִּיתֶ֥ם אֶֽת־אָזְנְכֶ֖ם לִשְׁמֹֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Yahweh to you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending, and not you listened, and not you inclined your ear to hear,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has sent to you all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets, rising early and sending [them], but you have not listened, nor have you inclined your ear to hear,
en.B: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has sent you all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets again and again, but you have not listened or even paid attention.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has also sent you all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets, over and over. But you would not listen. You would not even pay attention.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha enviado a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas, madrugando y enviando[los], pero no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado, ni {{plural_you:han|habéis}} inclinado {{plural_you:su oído|vuestro oído}} para oír,
es.B: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha enviado una y otra vez a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas, pero no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado ni {{plural_you:han|habéis}} prestado atención.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} también {{plural_you:les|os}} ha enviado a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas, una y otra vez. Pero no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} escuchar. Ni siquiera {{plural_you:prestaron|prestasteis}} atención.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a envoyé tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes, se levant de bonne heure et [les] envoyant, mais vous n’avez pas écouté, et vous n’avez pas tendu l’oreille pour entendre,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a envoyé sans relâche tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes, mais vous n’avez pas écouté, vous n’avez même pas prêté attention.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a aussi envoyé tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes, encore et encore. Mais vous n’avez pas voulu écouter. Vous n’avez même pas fait attention.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewatumia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote manabii, akiamka mapema na kuwatuma, lakini hamkusikiliza, wala hamkutega sikio lenu kusikia,
sw.B: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewatumia tena na tena watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, manabii, lakini hamkusikiliza wala hata kujali.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewatumia pia mara nyingi sana watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote, manabii. Lakini hamkutaka kusikiliza. Hata hamkujali.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai đến với các người mọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri, dậy sớm mà sai [họ] đến, nhưng các người không nghe, cũng không nghiêng tai để nghe,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã sai mọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri đến với các người hết lần này đến lần khác, nhưng các người không nghe, cũng chẳng thèm lắng tai.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng đã nhiều lần sai mọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri đến với các người. Nhưng các người không chịu nghe. Các người cũng chẳng thèm để ý.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 모든 종 예언자들을 너희에게 일찍 일어나 보내셨으나, 너희는 듣지 않았고 귀를 기울여 듣지도 않았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 예언자들을 모두 너희에게 거듭거듭 보내셨으나, 너희는 듣지 않았고 귀를 기울이지도 않았다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 종 예언자들도 모두 너희에게 몇 번이고 보내셨다. 그러나 너희는 듣지 않았다. 귀를 기울이지도 않았다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou a vocês todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas, madrugando e [os] enviando, mas vocês não ouviram, nem inclinaram o ouvido para ouvir,
pt.B: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou a vocês repetidas vezes todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas, mas vocês não ouviram nem prestaram atenção.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} também enviou a vocês todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas, muitas e muitas vezes. Mas vocês não quiseram ouvir. Não quiseram nem prestar atenção.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ባሪያዎቹን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ማልዶ እየላከ ወደ እናንተ ላከ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፤ ለመስማትም ጆሯችሁን አላዘነበላችሁም፤
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም አገልጋዮቹን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ደጋግሞ ወደ እናንተ ላከ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፤ ልብ እንኳ አላላችሁም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አገልጋዮቹን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ደግሞ ደጋግሞ ወደ እናንተ ልኳል። እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም። ልብ እንኳ አላላችሁም።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने सब दासों, भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को तड़के उठ उठकर तुम्हारे पास भेजा है, पर तुमने नहीं सुना, और न सुनने के लिए अपना कान लगाया,
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने सब दासों, भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को बार-बार तुम्हारे पास भेजा है, पर तुमने न सुना और न ध्यान दिया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने सब दासों, अपने नबियों को भी बार-बार तुम्हारे पास भेजा। पर तुमने सुनना नहीं चाहा। तुमने ध्यान तक नहीं दिया।

ru.L: И посылал к вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} всех своих рабов, пророков, вставая рано и посылая [их], но вы не слушали и не склоняли вашего уха, чтобы слышать,
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} снова и снова посылал к вам всех своих рабов, пророков, но вы не слушали и даже не прислушивались.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} снова и снова посылал к вам всех своих рабов, пророков. Но вы не хотели слушать. Вы даже не обращали внимания.

ja.L: また、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分のしもべである預言者たちをみな、朝早くから遣わし続けて、あなたがたのもとに送られたが、あなたがたは聞かず、聞こうとして耳を傾けることもしなかった。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分のしもべである預言者たちをみな、繰り返しあなたがたのもとに遣わされたが、あなたがたは聞かず、耳を傾けることさえしなかった。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はまた、ご自分のしもべである預言者たちをみな、何度も何度もあなたたちのもとに遣わされた。しかし、あなたたちは聞こうとしなかった。耳を傾けることさえしなかった。

uk.L: І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} посилав до вас усіх своїх рабів-пророків, рано встаючи і посилаючи, але ви не слухали і не нахиляли вашого вуха, щоб слухати,
uk.B: І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} знову й знову посилав до вас усіх своїх рабів-пророків, але ви не слухали і навіть не зважали.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} також раз у раз посилав до вас усіх своїх рабів-пророків. Але ви не хотіли слухати. Ви навіть не зважали.

decisions.choice: his servants the prophets: those who served God by bringing his word
decisions.reason: As in 7:25. Jeremiah was not alone: the LORD had sent prophet after prophet with the same call (2 Kings 17:13).

decisions.choice: rising early and sending: sending them constantly
decisions.reason: As in 7:25.

decisions.choice: you did not incline your ear: you did not even turn to listen
decisions.reason: To bend the ear toward someone is to give attention. The people refused even the first step of hearing (7:24, 26; 11:8).

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: As in 7:25, "servant" is kept at every level when the word names those who serve God.

decisions.choice: rising early and sending (L); again and again (B); over and over (R); inclined your ear (L); paid attention (B, R)
decisions.reason: The set wording for the first phrase; Balanced and Readable give the sense of the ear idiom. The Literal sentence runs on into verse 5 and ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: siervos
decisions.reason: God's servants the prophets are "siervos" at every level, as the terms note sets for the servant of the LORD.

decisions.choice: watumishi wake manabii
decisions.reason: God's servants the prophets are "watumishi" at every level, never "watumwa", as the terms note sets for the servant of the LORD.

decisions.choice: "serviteurs" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Kings note sets for God's named servants in French: "serviteur" at every level, Literal included.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ" (servants)
decisions.reason: God's servants the prophets are "đầy tớ" at every level, Literal included, as the terms note settles; "nô lệ" is kept for slavery itself (34:8-22).

decisions.choice: "종" for God's servants the prophets
decisions.reason: As the terms note: "종" at every level, never "노예".

decisions.choice: servos (every level)
decisions.reason: As set at 7:25: where the word names those who serve God, "servos" stands at every level, also at Literal.

decisions.choice: अपने दास, भविष्यद्वक्ता
decisions.reason: "His servants the prophets" keeps दास at every level, as the terms note sets for ʿeved and as 2 Kings 24:2 has "अपने दासों, भविष्यद्वक्ताओं".

decisions.choice: рабы-пророки
decisions.reason: God's servants the prophets take "раб" at every level, as the Pentateuch note sets for ʿeved and as Revelation 10:7 has "рабам Своим пророкам".

decisions.choice: 'avadav hannevi'im "ご自分のしもべである預言者たち" (every level), the third-person form of 7:25's "わたしのしもべである預言者たち"; hashkem veshaloach "朝早くから遣わし続けて" (L), "繰り返し" (B), "何度も何度も" (R).
alternatives: ご自分の奴隷である預言者たち
decisions.reason: JER conventions: しもべ at every level; respect forms for the LORD in Jeremiah's mouth ("送られた", "遣わされた").

source.text: לֵאמֹ֗ר שֽׁוּבוּ־נָ֞א אִ֣ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֤וֹ הָֽרָעָה֙ וּמֵרֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: saying: Turn please each from his way the evil and from [the] evil of your deeds, and dwell on the land which gave Yahweh to you and to your fathers from of old and until forever.

en.L: saying, 'Turn now, each one from {{gender:their|his}} evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and dwell in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to you and to your fathers from of old and forever.
en.B: They said, 'Turn back, every one of you, from your evil ways and your evil deeds, and you will live in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to you and your ancestors to keep for all time.
en.R: The prophets told you, 'Each of you must stop living in your evil ways and doing evil things. Then you can live in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to you and to your ancestors, to be yours forever.

es.L: diciendo: “{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} ahora cada uno de su mal camino y de la maldad de {{plural_you:sus obras|vuestras obras}}, y {{plural_you:habiten|habitad}} en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} desde antiguo y para siempre.
es.B: Ellos decían: “{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, de {{plural_you:sus malos caminos y de sus malas obras|vuestros malos caminos y de vuestras malas obras}}, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} para siempre.
es.R: Los profetas {{plural_you:les|os}} decían: “Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe dejar de vivir en sus malos caminos y de hacer el mal. Entonces {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} vivir en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, para que fuera {{plural_you:suya|vuestra}} para siempre.

fr.L: disant : “Revenez donc, chacun de sa mauvaise voie et de la méchanceté de vos actions, et habitez sur la terre que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donnée, à vous et à vos pères, depuis toujours et pour toujours.
fr.B: Ils disaient : “Revenez, chacun de vous, de votre mauvaise conduite et de vos mauvaises actions, et vous habiterez le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné, à vous et à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, pour toujours.
fr.R: Les prophètes vous disaient : “Que chacun de vous abandonne sa mauvaise conduite et arrête de faire le mal. Alors vous pourrez habiter le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a donné, à vous et à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, pour qu’il soit à vous pour toujours.

sw.L: wakisema, 'Rudini sasa, kila mmoja kutoka njia yake mbaya na kutoka uovu wa matendo yenu, mkae katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ninyi na baba zenu tangu zamani hata milele.
sw.B: Walisema, 'Rudini, kila mmoja wenu, mziache njia zenu mbaya na matendo yenu maovu, nanyi mtakaa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ninyi na babu zenu iwe yenu daima.
sw.R: Manabii waliwaambia, 'Kila mmoja wenu na aache kuishi katika njia zake mbaya na kutenda maovu. Ndipo mtaweza kuishi katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ninyi na babu zenu, iwe yenu milele.

vi.L: rằng: 'Mỗi người hãy quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình và khỏi điều ác trong việc làm của các ngươi, thì các ngươi sẽ ở trên đất mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho các ngươi và cho tổ phụ các ngươi từ xưa cho đến đời đời.
vi.B: Họ nói: 'Mỗi người trong các ngươi hãy quay lại khỏi đường lối gian ác và những việc làm xấu xa của mình, thì các ngươi sẽ được ở trên đất mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi để giữ mãi mãi.
vi.R: Các nhà tiên tri đã bảo các người: 'Mỗi người trong các ngươi phải thôi sống theo đường lối gian ác và thôi làm điều ác. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ được sống trên đất {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi, để làm sản nghiệp đời đời.

ko.L: 그들이 말했다. '너희는 저마다 자기의 악한 길과 너희 행실의 악에서 돌아오너라. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 너희 조상들에게 예로부터 영원히 주신 그 땅에서 살 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 말했다. '너희는 모두 저마다 악한 길과 악한 행실에서 돌아오너라. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 너희 조상들에게 영원히 주신 땅에서 살게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 예언자들은 너희에게 말했다. '너희는 저마다 악하게 사는 길에서 돌아오너라. 악한 일을 그만두어라. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 너희 조상들에게 영원히 주신 땅에서 살 수 있을 것이다.

pt.L: dizendo: 'Voltem agora, cada um do seu mau caminho e da maldade das suas ações, e habitem na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a vocês e aos seus pais, desde sempre e para sempre.
pt.B: Eles diziam: 'Voltem, cada um de vocês, dos seus maus caminhos e das suas más ações, e vocês viverão na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a vocês e aos seus antepassados, para ser de vocês para sempre.
pt.R: Os profetas diziam a vocês: 'Cada um de vocês precisa deixar de viver nos seus maus caminhos e de fazer coisas más. Então vocês vão poder viver na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a vocês e aos seus antepassados, para ser de vocês para sempre.

am.L: እንዲህ ሲሉ፦ “እያንዳንዳችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከሥራችሁ ክፋት እባካችሁ ተመለሱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ ከጥንት ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም በሰጣት ምድር ላይ ተቀመጡ።
am.B: እንዲህም አሉ፦ “እያንዳንዳችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከክፉ ሥራችሁ ተመለሱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ ለዘለቄታው በሰጣት ምድር ትኖራላችሁ።
am.R: ነቢያቱ እንዲህ አሏችሁ፦ “እያንዳንዳችሁ በክፉ መንገዳችሁ መሄዳችሁንና ክፉ ነገር ማድረጋችሁን ተዉ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእናንተና ለቅድመ አያቶቻችሁ ለዘላለም የእናንተ እንድትሆን በሰጣት ምድር ትኖራላችሁ።

hi.L: कि, 'अब तुम में से हर एक अपने बुरे मार्ग से और अपने कामों की बुराई से फिरो, और उस देश में बसे रहो जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हें और तुम्हारे पुरखाओं को प्राचीनकाल से सदा के लिए दिया है।
hi.B: उन्होंने कहा, 'तुम में से हर एक अपने बुरे मार्ग और अपने बुरे कामों से फिरे, तब तुम उस देश में बसे रहोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हें और तुम्हारे पूर्वजों को सदा के लिए दिया है।
hi.R: नबियों ने तुमसे कहा, 'तुम में से हर एक अपने बुरे चालचलन और बुरे कामों को छोड़ दे। तब तुम उस देश में रह सकोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने तुम्हें और तुम्हारे पूर्वजों को दिया है, कि वह सदा तुम्हारा रहे।

ru.L: говоря: “Обратитесь же каждый от своего злого пути и от зла ваших дел, и живите на земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал вам и вашим отцам от века и навеки.
ru.B: Они говорили: “Обратитесь каждый от своего злого пути и от злых дел, и вы будете жить на земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал вам и вашим предкам на все времена.
ru.R: Пророки говорили вам: “Пусть каждый из вас перестанет жить по-злому и делать зло. Тогда вы будете жить в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал вам и вашим предкам, чтобы она была вашей навсегда.

ja.L: [彼らは]言った。『さあ、それぞれ自分の悪の道から、またあなたがたの悪い行いから立ち帰れ。そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が昔からとこしえまで、あなたがたとあなたがたの父たちに与えられた土地に住め。
ja.B: 彼らは言った。『あなたがたはそれぞれ、悪の道と悪い行いから立ち帰りなさい。そうすれば、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたと先祖に与えられた土地に、いつまでも住むことができる。
ja.R: 預言者たちはあなたたちに言った。『あなたたちはそれぞれ、悪い生き方をやめ、悪いことをするのをやめなさい。そうすれば、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたたちと先祖に与えられた土地に、住むことができる。その土地は、いつまでもあなたたちのものだ。

uk.L: кажучи: “Наверніться ж, кожен від своєї злої дороги і від зла ваших учинків, і живіть на землі, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав вам і вашим батькам від віків і навіки.
uk.B: Вони казали: “Наверніться, кожен із вас, від ваших злих доріг і від ваших лихих учинків, і ви житимете на землі, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав вам і вашим предкам, щоб вона була вашою на всі часи.
uk.R: Пророки казали вам: “Кожен із вас мусить перестати жити злим життям і чинити зло. Тоді ви зможете жити на землі, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав вам і вашим предкам, щоб вона була вашою навіки.

decisions.choice: turn: repent, come back from evil to the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb is Jeremiah's key word for repentance (3:12, 14, 22; 18:11). It means a turning of the whole life, here from evil ways and deeds.

decisions.choice: and dwell: the result promised to those who turn
decisions.reason: The second command follows the first as its outcome: turn, and you will live in the land. The same promise stands in the temple sermon (7:3, 7).

decisions.choice: from of old and forever: the land given for all time
decisions.reason: The double phrase covers the whole span from the gift to the ancestors on into the future, as in 7:7. The gift was lasting, but living in it depended on faithfulness.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks for the prophets' words, inside Jeremiah's speech
decisions.reason: Jeremiah quotes what the prophets said, so their words take single quotation marks. Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence and supply "They said" or "The prophets told you"; Readable also supplies "must" and "Then" to show that living in the land depended on turning. Literal follows 18:11 for "each one from their evil way", with the gender setting, since the call is to men and women alike.

decisions.choice: the prophets' message uses God's "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: The message the prophets brought is God's own word, in which he speaks as "Ta" (verse 6), so it takes God's address to the people.

decisions.choice: Verses 4-5 closed as separate sentences
decisions.reason: Korean cannot place a quotation's verb before verse 5's marker, so verse 4 ends and verse 5 opens with "그들이 말했다"; the prophets' words take single quotation marks inside Jeremiah's speech.

decisions.choice: cada um do seu mau caminho (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "their/his" under the gender setting; Portuguese "cada um ... do seu" already means any person, so there is no second wording, as in 23:14.

decisions.choice: No gender span on "each one"
decisions.reason: The Amharic says "እያንዳንዳችሁ" (each of you) with second person plural forms, which include men and women; there is nothing for the English his/their setting to change.

decisions.choice: हर एक अपने, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "their / his" under the gender setting. Hindi अपने is the same for men and women, so the sentence is already inclusive and needs no span. This holds for this file.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "каждый ... своего"
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span for "their / his"; Russian "каждый" and the reflexive "своего" already cover men and women, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: shuvu na' 'ish "さあ、それぞれ…立ち帰れ" (L), "それぞれ…立ち帰りなさい" (B), "それぞれ…やめなさい" (R); no gender span ("それぞれ", "自分の").
decisions.reason: The JER shuv forms; the prophets' words in 『』 inside Jeremiah's speech, as the English single quotation marks.

source.text: וְאַל־תֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תַכְעִ֤יסוּ אוֹתִי֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָרַ֖ע לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not go after gods other to serve them and to bow down to them, and not provoke me with [the] work of your hands, and not I will do harm to you.

en.L: And do not go after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them, and do not provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.'
en.B: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them. Do not make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry with the idols your hands have made, and I will not harm you.'
en.R: Do not follow other gods. Do not serve them or bow down to worship them. Do not make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry by worshiping idols you have made with your own hands. If you obey, I will not punish you.'

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} tras otros dioses para servirles y postrarse ante ellos, y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:provoquen|provoquéis}} a ira con la obra de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}; y no {{plural_you:les|os}} haré mal”.
es.B: No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} a otros dioses para servirles y adorarlos. No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} enojar con los ídolos que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} con {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}, y no {{plural_you:les|os}} haré daño”.
es.R: No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} a otros dioses. No les {{plural_you:sirvan|sirváis}} ni {{plural_you:se inclinen|os inclinéis}} para adorarlos. No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} enojar adorando ídolos que {{plural_you:ustedes mismos han|vosotros mismos habéis}} hecho con {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}. Si {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}}, no {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré”.

fr.L: Et n’allez pas après d’autres dieux pour les servir et vous prosterner devant eux, et ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irritez pas par l’œuvre de vos mains ; alors je ne vous ferai pas de mal.”
fr.B: Ne suivez pas d’autres dieux pour les servir et les adorer. Ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irritez pas par les idoles que vos mains ont faites, et je ne vous ferai pas de mal.”
fr.R: Ne suivez pas d’autres dieux. Ne les servez pas et ne vous prosternez pas devant eux pour les adorer. Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mettez pas en colère en adorant des idoles que vous avez faites de vos propres mains. Si vous obéissez, je ne vous punirai pas.”

sw.L: Wala msiifuate miungu mingine ili kuitumikia na kuisujudia, wala msinikasirishe kwa kazi ya mikono yenu; nami sitawadhuru.'
sw.B: Msiifuate miungu mingine ili kuitumikia na kuiabudu. Msinikasirishe kwa sanamu mlizozitengeneza kwa mikono yenu, nami sitawadhuru.'
sw.R: Msiifuate miungu mingine. Msiitumikie wala msiisujudie kuiabudu. Msinikasirishe kwa kuabudu sanamu mlizotengeneza kwa mikono yenu wenyewe. Mkitii, sitawaadhibu.'

vi.L: Đừng đi theo các thần khác để phục vụ và quỳ lạy chúng, đừng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng công việc tay các ngươi làm; thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không làm hại các ngươi.'
vi.B: Đừng đi theo các thần khác để phục vụ và thờ lạy chúng. Đừng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thần tượng do tay các ngươi làm ra, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không làm hại các ngươi.'
vi.R: Đừng đi theo các thần khác. Đừng phục vụ hay cúi lạy thờ chúng. Đừng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng cách thờ những thần tượng do chính tay các ngươi làm ra. Nếu các ngươi vâng lời, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không phạt các ngươi.'

ko.L: 다른 신들을 따라가 그들을 섬기거나 그들에게 절하지 말고, 너희 손으로 만든 것으로 나를 노엽게 하지 마라. 그러면 내가 너희에게 해를 끼치지 않을 것이다.'
ko.B: 다른 신들을 따라가 섬기거나 경배하지 마라. 너희 손으로 만든 우상들로 나를 노엽게 하지 마라. 그러면 내가 너희를 해치지 않겠다.'
ko.R: 다른 신들을 따르지 마라. 그들을 섬기거나 그들에게 절하지 마라. 너희 손으로 만든 우상을 섬겨서 나를 화나게 하지 마라. 너희가 순종하면 내가 너희를 벌하지 않겠다.'

pt.L: E não sigam outros deuses para servi-los e para se prostrar diante deles, e não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provoquem à ira com a obra das suas mãos; então não lhes farei mal.'
pt.B: Não sigam outros deuses para servi-los e adorá-los. Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixem irado com os ídolos que as suas mãos fizeram, e eu não lhes farei mal.'
pt.R: Não sigam outros deuses. Não os sirvam nem se curvem para adorá-los. Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixem irado adorando ídolos que vocês mesmos fizeram com as próprias mãos. Se obedecerem, eu não vou castigar vocês.'

am.L: ታገለግሏቸውና ትሰግዱላቸው ዘንድ ሌሎች አማልክትን አትከተሉ፤ በእጃችሁም ሥራ አታስቆጡኝ፤ እኔም ክፉ አላደርግባችሁም።”
am.B: ልታገለግሏቸውና ልታመልኳቸው ሌሎች አማልክትን አትከተሉ። በእጃችሁ በሠራችኋቸው ጣዖታት አታስቆጡኝ፤ እኔም አልጎዳችሁም።”
am.R: ሌሎች አማልክትን አትከተሉ። አታገልግሏቸው፤ አትስገዱላቸውም። በገዛ እጃችሁ የሠራችኋቸውን ጣዖታት በማምለክ አታስቆጡኝ። ብትታዘዙ አልቀጣችሁም።”

hi.L: और दूसरे देवताओं के पीछे उनकी सेवा करने और उन्हें दंडवत करने को न जाओ, और अपने हाथों के काम से मुझे क्रोध न दिलाओ; तब मैं तुम्हारी कोई हानि न करूँगा।'
hi.B: दूसरे देवताओं के पीछे चलकर उनकी सेवा और उपासना न करो। अपने हाथों की बनाई मूर्तियों से मुझे क्रोध न दिलाओ, तो मैं तुम्हारी हानि न करूँगा।'
hi.R: दूसरे देवताओं के पीछे मत जाओ। उनकी सेवा मत करो और उनके आगे झुककर उनकी पूजा मत करो। अपने ही हाथों से बनाई मूर्तियों की पूजा करके मुझे क्रोध मत दिलाओ। यदि तुम मेरी बात मानोगे, तो मैं तुम्हें दंड नहीं दूँगा।'

ru.L: И не ходите за другими богами, чтобы служить им и поклоняться им, и не гневите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} делом ваших рук, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не сделаю вам зла.”
ru.B: Не следуйте за другими богами, не служите им и не поклоняйтесь им. Не гневите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} идолами, сделанными вашими руками, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не причиню вам зла.”
ru.R: Не идите за другими богами. Не служите им и не кланяйтесь им. Не гневите {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, поклоняясь идолам, которых вы сделали своими руками. Если вы послушаетесь, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не накажу вас.”

ja.L: ほかの神々に従って行って、それらに仕え、それらにひれ伏すな。あなたがたの手のわざで、わたしを怒らせるな。そうすれば、わたしはあなたがたに害を加えない。』
ja.B: ほかの神々に従って、それらに仕え、それらを拝んではならない。あなたがたが手で造った偶像によって、わたしを怒らせてはならない。そうすれば、わたしはあなたがたに害を加えない。』
ja.R: ほかの神々に従ってはいけない。それらに仕えたり、ひれ伏して拝んだりしてはいけない。自分の手で造った偶像を拝んで、わたしを怒らせてはいけない。もし従うなら、わたしはあなたたちを罰しない。』

uk.L: І не ходіть за іншими богами, щоб служити їм і кланятися їм, і не гнівіть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ділом ваших рук; тоді {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не заподію вам зла”.
uk.B: Не ходіть за іншими богами, щоб служити їм і поклонятися їм. Не гнівіть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ідолами, які зробили ваші руки, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не заподію вам зла”.
uk.R: Не ходіть за іншими богами. Не служіть їм і не вклоняйтеся їм. Не гнівіть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, поклоняючись ідолам, яких ви зробили власними руками. Якщо послухаєтеся, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не каратиму вас”.

decisions.choice: go after other gods: give loyalty to other gods
decisions.reason: To go after someone is to follow them as one's master. The phrase comes from the covenant warnings (Deuteronomy 6:14; 8:19) and runs through Jeremiah (7:6, 9; 11:10).

decisions.choice: the work of your hands: idols made by human hands
decisions.reason: The phrase means the idols, things people make and then worship (1:16; Deuteronomy 4:28). It could also mean their deeds in general, but beside "other gods" the idols are meant.

decisions.choice: provoke me ... I will do you no harm: God speaks in his own voice inside the prophets' message
decisions.reason: The prophets spoke God's words in his name, so the message they gave says "me" and "I" of God.

decisions.choice: If you obey, I will not punish you
decisions.reason: Readable supplies "If you obey" to show the condition, and says "punish" for the harm God would bring as judgment.

decisions.choice: "나를", "내가" inside the prophets' message
decisions.reason: God speaks in his own voice within the prophets' message (meaning decision m3); Korean keeps the first person and God's plain style.

decisions.choice: God's own voice inside the prophets' message (m3): "わたしを怒らせる", "わたしは…害を加えない" (L, B), "罰しない" (R).
decisions.reason: m3; the oracle command forms 〜するな (L), 〜してはならない (B), 〜してはいけない (R).

source.text: וְלֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֧עַן הַכְעִיסֵ֛נִי בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶ֖ם לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But not you have listened to me, declaration of Yahweh, so as to provoke me with [the] work of your hands to harm to you.

en.L: But you have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so that you have provoked {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger with the work of your hands, to your own harm.
en.B: But you have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You have made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry with the idols your hands have made, and brought harm on yourselves.
en.R: But you would not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry with the idols you made, and so you have brought trouble on yourselves.

es.L: Pero no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de modo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han|habéis}} provocado a ira con la obra de {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}, para {{plural_you:su propio mal|vuestro propio mal}}.
es.B: Pero no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Me {{plural_you:han|habéis}} hecho enojar con los ídolos que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} con {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}, y {{plural_you:se han|os habéis}} traído desgracia a {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}.
es.R: Pero no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} escucharme, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Me {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} enojar con los ídolos que {{plural_you:fabricaron|fabricasteis}}, y así {{plural_you:se han|os habéis}} buscado problemas.

fr.L: Mais vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas écouté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, de sorte que vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez irrité par l’œuvre de vos mains, pour votre malheur.
fr.B: Mais vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas écouté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez irrité par les idoles que vos mains ont faites, et vous avez attiré le malheur sur vous.
fr.R: Mais vous n’avez pas voulu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez mis en colère avec les idoles que vous avez fabriquées, et vous vous êtes ainsi attiré des malheurs.

sw.L: Lakini hamkunisikiliza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hata mkanikasirisha kwa kazi ya mikono yenu, kwa madhara yenu wenyewe.
sw.B: Lakini hamkunisikiliza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mmenikasirisha kwa sanamu mlizotengeneza kwa mikono yenu, mkajiletea madhara wenyewe.
sw.R: Lakini hamkutaka kunisikiliza, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mlinikasirisha kwa sanamu mlizotengeneza, na hivyo mmejiletea taabu wenyewe.

vi.L: Nhưng các ngươi đã không nghe Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, đến nỗi các ngươi đã chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng công việc tay các ngươi làm, chuốc lấy tai hại cho chính mình.
vi.B: Nhưng các ngươi đã không nghe Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Các ngươi đã chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thần tượng do tay các ngươi làm ra, và chuốc lấy tai họa cho chính mình.
vi.R: Nhưng các ngươi không chịu nghe Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Các ngươi đã chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thần tượng do các ngươi làm ra, nên các ngươi đã tự chuốc lấy tai họa cho mình.

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그래서 너희 손으로 만든 것으로 나를 노엽게 하여 너희 자신에게 해를 끼쳤다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 너희는 너희 손으로 만든 우상들로 나를 노엽게 했고, 스스로 해를 불러들였다.
ko.R: 그러나 너희는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 너희는 너희가 만든 우상들로 나를 화나게 했다. 그래서 너희 스스로 화를 불러들였다.

pt.L: Mas vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouviram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, de modo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provocaram à ira com a obra das suas mãos, para o seu próprio mal.
pt.B: Mas vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouviram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixaram irado com os ídolos que as suas mãos fizeram e trouxeram o mal sobre vocês mesmos.
pt.R: Mas vocês não quiseram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvir, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixaram irado com os ídolos que fizeram, e por isso trouxeram desgraça sobre vocês mesmos.

am.L: እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁኝም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ በእጃችሁም ሥራ ለራሳችሁ ጉዳት አስቆጣችሁኝ።
am.B: እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁኝም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። በእጃችሁ በሠራችኋቸው ጣዖታት አስቆጣችሁኝ፤ በራሳችሁም ላይ ጉዳት አመጣችሁ።
am.R: እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁኝም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። በሠራችኋቸው ጣዖታት አስቆጣችሁኝ፤ ስለዚህም በራሳችሁ ላይ መከራ አመጣችሁ።

hi.L: पर तुमने मेरी नहीं सुनी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, यहाँ तक कि तुमने अपने हाथों के काम से मुझे क्रोध दिलाया, अपनी ही हानि के लिए।
hi.B: पर तुमने मेरी नहीं सुनी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। तुमने अपने हाथों की बनाई मूर्तियों से मुझे क्रोध दिलाया है और अपने ऊपर हानि ले आए हो।
hi.R: पर तुमने मेरी नहीं सुनी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। तुमने अपनी बनाई मूर्तियों से मुझे क्रोध दिलाया, और इस तरह अपने ऊपर मुसीबत ले आए।

ru.L: Но вы не слушали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — так что гневили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} делом ваших рук себе во зло.
ru.B: Но вы не слушали {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Вы гневили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} идолами, сделанными вашими руками, и навлекли беду на самих себя.
ru.R: Но вы не хотели слушать {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Вы гневили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} идолами, которых сами сделали, и так навлекли беду на самих себя.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたはわたしに聞き従わなかった――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。こうして、あなたがたは自分たちの手のわざでわたしを怒らせ、自分たちに災いを招いた。
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたはわたしに聞き従わなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。あなたがたは、手で造った偶像によってわたしを怒らせ、自分たちに災いを招いた。
ja.R: しかし、あなたたちはわたしに従おうとしなかった、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。あなたたちは、自分で造った偶像でわたしを怒らせ、自分たちに災いを招いた。

uk.L: Але ви не слухали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, так що гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ділом ваших рук собі на лихо.
uk.B: Але ви не слухали {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Ви гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ідолами, які зробили ваші руки, і накликали лихо на себе.
uk.R: Але ви не хотіли слухати {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Ви гнівили {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} ідолами, яких зробили, і так накликали біду на себе.

decisions.choice: you have not listened to me, declares the LORD: Jeremiah speaks God's words in God's own voice
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's report of his preaching turns into the LORD's own words, marked by "declares the LORD". There is no new quotation in the Hebrew; the prophet speaks for God.

decisions.choice: so that you provoked me ... to your harm: the result of their refusal, which turns back on themselves
decisions.reason: The word "so that" here marks what came of their actions, not their purpose. They angered God, and the harm fell on them. The Hebrew has a written form "so as to provoke me" with a marginal reading "they provoked me"; the sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: declares (L, B); says (R)
decisions.reason: The set wording for this formula, as in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable break the verse into shorter sentences.

decisions.choice: "ይላል እግዚአብሔር" for "declares the LORD"
decisions.reason: The terms list's wording for the prophetic formula, set after the words it marks, as the Amharic New Testament sets "ይላል ጌታ" (Hebrews 8:8-12, quoting Jeremiah 31). One wording at every level, where the English varies between "declares" and "says".

decisions.choice: प्रभु की यह वाणी है (L, B); प्रभु कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: neʾum YHWH keeps the one wording per level the terms note sets for the Prophets, as Jeremiah 1:8 has it. The same holds through this block.

decisions.choice: — слово ГОСПОДА (L); говорит ГОСПОДЬ (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula neʾum YHWH keeps the noun at Literal, set off with dashes, and is "говорит ГОСПОДЬ" at Balanced and Readable, one wording per level through the Prophets.

source.text: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־דְּבָרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh of hosts: Because that not you have listened to my words,

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: Because you have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words,
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: Because you have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words,
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: You have not listened to what I said.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Por cuanto no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras,
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Por cuanto no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras,
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: {{plural_you:Ustedes no han|Vosotros no habéis}} escuchado lo que yo dije.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Parce que vous n’avez pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles,
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Parce que vous n’avez pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles,
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Vous n’avez pas écouté ce que j’ai dit.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Kwa sababu hamkuyasikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}},
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Kwa sababu hamkuyasikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}},
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Hamkusikiliza yale niliyosema.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Vì các ngươi đã không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Vì các ngươi đã không nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Các ngươi đã không nghe những điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phán.

ko.L: 그러므로 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 내 말을 듣지 않았으므로,
ko.B: 그러므로 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 내 말을 듣지 않았으므로,
ko.R: 그래서 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희는 내 말을 듣지 않았다.

pt.L: Portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Porque vocês não ouviram as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras,
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Porque vocês não ouviram as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras,
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Vocês não escutaram o que eu disse.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ ቃሌን ስላልሰማችሁ፣
am.B: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ቃሌን ስላልሰማችሁ፣
am.R: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የተናገርኩትን አልሰማችሁም።

hi.L: इसलिए सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: इसलिए कि तुमने मेरे वचन नहीं सुने,
hi.B: इसलिए सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: क्योंकि तुमने मेरे वचन नहीं सुने,
hi.R: इसलिए सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुमने मेरी बात नहीं सुनी।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Так как вы не слушали {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов,
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф: Так как вы не послушались {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} слов,
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств: Вы не послушались того, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал.

ja.L: それゆえ、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたがわたしの言葉を聞かなかったので、
ja.B: それゆえ、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたがわたしの言葉に聞き従わなかったので、
ja.R: だから、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたたちは、わたしが言ったことを聞かなかった。

uk.L: Тому так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот: Через те, що ви не слухали {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів,
uk.B: Тож так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ: Через те, що ви не слухали {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} слів,
uk.R: Тож ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель: Ви не слухали того, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} казав.

decisions.choice: therefore: the judgment that follows from twenty-three years of refusal
decisions.reason: The word links the sentence of judgment (verses 8-11) to the refusal described in verses 3-7. Inside Jeremiah's speech the LORD's words now follow directly.

decisions.choice: listened to: obeyed
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's words is to do what they say. The same verb runs through verses 3, 4 and 7.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Balanced and Readable say "Armies" for "hosts" (see Isaiah 1:9).

decisions.choice: a separate sentence
decisions.reason: Readable makes the reason its own sentence; verse 9 then states what God will do. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew sentence running into verse 9.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के प्रभु at every level
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "the LORD of Armies"; Hindi सेनाओं (armies, hosts) already says this, so the one form सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} serves every level, as Romans 9:29 and the terms note have it.

decisions.choice: ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф (L, B); ГОСПОДЬ Воинств (R)
decisions.reason: YHWH of hosts takes the forms of the history and prophets notes: Саваоф (as Romans 9:29) at Literal and Balanced, Воинств at Readable, where the English has "of Armies".

decisions.choice: Так говорит ГОСПОДЬ (L, B); Вот что говорит ГОСПОДЬ (R)
decisions.reason: The formula koh amar YHWH in the wording the prophets note sets for each level, used the same way through the whole block.

source.text: הִנְנִ֣י שֹׁלֵ֡חַ וְלָקַחְתִּי֩ אֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפְּח֨וֹת צָפ֜וֹן נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶל־נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֮ עַבְדִּי֒ וַהֲבִ֨אֹתִ֜ים עַל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־יֹ֣שְׁבֶ֔יהָ וְעַ֛ל כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה סָבִ֑יב וְהַ֣חֲרַמְתִּ֔ים וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וּלְחָרְב֖וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: here I [am] sending and I will take all [the] clans of [the] north, declaration of Yahweh, and to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon my servant, and I will bring them on the land this and on its inhabitants and on all the nations these around, and I will devote them to destruction and I will make them into a horror and into a hissing and into ruins of forever.

en.L: look, I am sending and I will take all the clans of the north, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and [I am sending] to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, and I will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all these nations around [it]; and I will devote them to destruction, and I will make them a horror and a hissing and everlasting ruins.
en.B: I am going to send for all the peoples of the north, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant. I will bring them against this land and its people and against all the nations around it. I will devote them to destruction and make them a horror, an object of scorn, and ruins forever.
en.R: I am going to send for all the peoples from the north, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will send for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon. I will bring them to attack this land and the people who live here, and all the nations around you. I will destroy them all completely. People will be horrified at them and mock them. Those places will lie in ruins forever.

es.L: he aquí, yo envío y tomaré a todas las familias del norte, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y [enviaré] a Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, y los traeré contra esta tierra y contra sus habitantes y contra todas estas naciones de alrededor; y los consagraré al exterminio, y los pondré por horror y por burla y por ruinas eternas.
es.B: Voy a mandar a buscar a todos los pueblos del norte, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y a Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo. Los traeré contra esta tierra y sus habitantes, y contra todas las naciones que la rodean. Los destinaré a la destrucción y haré de ellos un horror, un objeto de burla y ruinas para siempre.
es.R: Voy a mandar a buscar a todos los pueblos del norte, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Mandaré a buscar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia. Los traeré para que ataquen esta tierra y a la gente que vive aquí, y a todas las naciones que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodean. Los destruiré a todos por completo. La gente se horrorizará al verlos y se burlará de ellos. Esos lugares quedarán en ruinas para siempre.

fr.L: voici, j’envoie chercher tous les clans du nord, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et [j’envoie] vers Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, et je les ferai venir contre ce pays et contre ses habitants et contre toutes ces nations alentour ; et je les vouerai à l’interdit, et je ferai d’eux une horreur, un objet de sifflements et des ruines éternelles.
fr.B: Je vais envoyer chercher tous les peuples du nord, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ainsi que Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur. Je les ferai venir contre ce pays et ses habitants, et contre toutes les nations qui l’entourent. Je les vouerai à l’interdit et j’en ferai un objet d’horreur et de moquerie, des ruines pour toujours.
fr.R: Je vais faire venir tous les peuples du nord, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je ferai venir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone. Je les amènerai pour attaquer ce pays et ceux qui y habitent, et toutes les nations qui vous entourent. Je les détruirai complètement. Les gens seront horrifiés en les voyant et se moqueront d’eux. Ces lieux resteront en ruines pour toujours.

sw.L: tazama, ninatuma na kuzichukua jamaa zote za kaskazini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na [ninatuma] kwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitawaleta juu ya nchi hii na juu ya wakazi wake na juu ya mataifa haya yote yaliyo kandokando; nami nitawaangamiza kabisa, na kuwafanya kuwa kitisho na [kitu cha] kuzomewa na magofu ya milele.
sw.B: ninakaribia kuwaita watu wote wa kaskazini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nitawaleta dhidi ya nchi hii na watu wake, na dhidi ya mataifa yote yanayoizunguka. Nitawaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi na kuwafanya kuwa kitisho, kitu cha kudharauliwa na magofu ya milele.
sw.R: Ninakaribia kuwaita watu wote wa kaskazini, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitamwita mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli. Nitawaleta waishambulie nchi hii na watu wanaoishi hapa, na mataifa yote yanayowazunguka. Nitawaangamiza wote kabisa. Watu wataogopa wakiwaona na kuwadhihaki. Mahali hapo patakuwa magofu milele.

vi.L: kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai đi và đem đến mọi gia tộc phương bắc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và [sai đến] Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, đầy tớ Ta, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem chúng đến đánh xứ này, đánh cư dân nó và đánh mọi dân tộc chung quanh này; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tận diệt chúng và làm cho chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng, một tiếng huýt sáo, và nơi hoang tàn đời đời.
vi.B: Ta sắp sai đi gọi mọi dân tộc phương bắc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và gọi Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, đầy tớ Ta. Ta sẽ đem chúng đến đánh xứ này, dân cư xứ này và mọi dân tộc chung quanh. Ta sẽ tận diệt chúng, làm cho chúng thành một điều kinh hoàng, một mối nhạo báng, và nơi hoang tàn mãi mãi.
vi.R: Ta sắp sai đi gọi mọi dân tộc ở phương bắc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ sai đi gọi đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn. Ta sẽ đem chúng đến tấn công xứ này, những người sống ở đây, và mọi dân tộc chung quanh. Ta sẽ hủy diệt tất cả. Người ta sẽ kinh hãi và chế giễu chúng. Những nơi ấy sẽ hoang tàn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 북쪽의 모든 족속과 내 종 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살을 불러 데려오겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 그들을 이 땅과 그 주민들과 주변의 이 모든 민족에게 오게 하여, 그들을 진멸하고, 공포와 휘파람거리와 영원한 폐허가 되게 하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 북쪽의 모든 민족과 내 종 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살을 불러오겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그들을 이 땅과 이 땅의 주민들과 주변의 모든 민족에게 쳐들어오게 하겠다. 내가 그 민족들을 진멸하여 공포의 대상과 비웃음거리와 영원한 폐허가 되게 하겠다.
ko.R: 내가 북쪽의 모든 민족을 불러오겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내 종 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살도 불러오겠다. 내가 그들이 이 땅과 이 땅에 사는 사람들과 주변의 모든 민족을 치게 하겠다. 내가 그들을 모두 완전히 멸망시키겠다. 사람들은 그들을 보고 몸서리치며 비웃을 것이다. 그곳들은 영원히 폐허로 남을 것이다.

pt.L: eis que eu estou enviando e tomarei todos os clãs do norte, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e [enviarei] a Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo, e os trarei contra esta terra, e contra os seus habitantes, e contra todas estas nações ao redor; e os destinarei à destruição, e farei deles um horror, e um assobio, e ruínas eternas.
pt.B: vou mandar buscar todos os povos do norte, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo. Eu os trarei contra esta terra e o seu povo, e contra todas as nações ao redor. Eu os destinarei à destruição e farei deles um horror, um objeto de zombaria e ruínas para sempre.
pt.R: Vou mandar buscar todos os povos do norte, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vou mandar buscar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia. Vou trazê-los para atacar esta terra e as pessoas que moram aqui, e todas as nações ao redor de vocês. Vou destruir todos eles completamente. As pessoas vão ficar horrorizadas com eles e vão zombar deles. Esses lugares vão ficar em ruínas para sempre.

am.L: እነሆ፣ የሰሜንን ጎሳዎች ሁሉ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ ባሪያዬንም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን ልኬ አስመጣለሁ፤ በዚህችም ምድር ላይ፣ በሚኖሩባትም ላይ፣ በዙሪያዋም ባሉት በእነዚህ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ ለጥፋትም እለያቸዋለሁ፤ ለድንጋጤና ለማፏጫ፣ ለዘላለምም ፍርስራሽ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
am.B: የሰሜን ወገኖችን ሁሉና አገልጋዬን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን ልኬ አስጠራለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። በዚህች ምድርና በሕዝቧ ላይ፣ በዙሪያዋም ባሉት ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ። ለጥፋት እለያቸዋለሁ፤ የድንጋጤና የመዘባበቻ ምልክት፣ ለዘላለምም ፍርስራሽ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
am.R: የሰሜን ወገኖችን ሁሉ ልኬ አስጠራለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። አገልጋዬን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርንም አስጠራለሁ። ይህችን ምድርና በእርሷ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች፣ በዙሪያችሁም ያሉትን ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እንዲወጉ አመጣቸዋለሁ። ሁሉንም ፈጽሜ አጠፋቸዋለሁ። ሰዎች እነርሱን አይተው ይደነግጣሉ፤ ይሳለቁባቸዋልም። እነዚያም ስፍራዎች ለዘላለም ፍርስራሽ ሆነው ይቀራሉ።

hi.L: देखो, मैं उत्तर के सब कुलों को बुलवा भेजूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और अपने दास बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर को [भी], और मैं उन्हें इस देश पर और इसके निवासियों पर और चारों ओर की इन सब जातियों पर ले आऊँगा; और मैं उन्हें सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित करूँगा, और उन्हें भय का कारण और सीटी का विषय और सदा के खंडहर बना दूँगा।
hi.B: मैं उत्तर के सब लोगों को, और अपने दास बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर को बुलवा भेजूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। मैं उन्हें इस देश और इसके लोगों पर, और इसके चारों ओर के सब देशों पर चढ़ा लाऊँगा। मैं उन्हें सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित करूँगा, और उन्हें भय का कारण, उपहास का विषय और सदा के खंडहर बना दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं उत्तर के सब लोगों को बुलवा भेजूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं अपने दास, बाबुल के राजा नबूकदरेस्सर को बुलवा भेजूँगा। मैं उन्हें इस देश पर, यहाँ रहनेवाले लोगों पर, और तुम्हारे चारों ओर के सब देशों पर हमला करने के लिए ले आऊँगा। मैं उन सब को पूरी तरह नष्ट कर दूँगा। लोग उन्हें देखकर डर जाएँगे और उनका मज़ाक़ उड़ाएँगे। वे स्थान सदा खंडहर पड़े रहेंगे।
